steps.text: While protected by The Riddler's shield, allies restore HP equal to 10% of The Riddler's Attack every 1s. When the shield breaks or expires, they immediately restore HP equal to 80% of The Riddler's Attack.

steps.label: Unlock
steps.text: Increases the wearer's Effect Accuracy by 10%. Every 5s, increases all other allies' Attack by 2%, stacking up to 24% and lasting until the end of battle.

steps.label: 5★ Blue
steps.text: Increases the wearer's Effect Accuracy by 20%. Every 5s, increases all other allies' Attack by 4%, stacking up to 48% and lasting until the end of battle.

steps.label: 5★ Yellow
steps.text: Increases the wearer's Effect Accuracy by 35%. Every 5s, increases all other allies' Attack by 6%, stacking up to 72% and lasting until the end of battle.

guide.text: The Riddler's signature gear. Continuously increases all allies' Attack and pairs perfectly with his shields. Also provides steady healing to shielded allies, plus bonus recovery when shields expire, greatly boosting your squad's survivability.
